verdict.rationale: The Ryzen 9 9950X3D is documented only as a 16-core desktop CPU for gaming and creator builds, with overclocking and socket-upgrade features. Nothing in the pack shows it shipping in thin, fanless or battery-powered machines, and there is no battery-life evidence. A reviewer's 'energy efficient' remark concerns desktop efficiency, which is adjacent rather than proof of all-day-battery designs. Power efficiency is a fair axis for any processor, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence
